title: Which byte guard stops a large Jev request

request.goal: Gateway.call is asked to send a valid Jev request whose packed JSON is 26,000 bytes. Is it sent? If not, give the error code and which module raises it. Where sources disagree, the current code is authoritative.

transport.title: scripts/transport.py (current)
transport.text:
MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 24000
...
        if role == "jev":
            jev.validate_request(payload, "openrouter")
        ...
        data = packed(payload).encode()
        require(len(data) <= MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, "request_byte_limit")

doc.title: docs/HANDOFF-HARDEN-JEV-PERMISSIONS.md (stale)
doc.text: Jev requests are bounded only by jev_decide's 28,000-byte guard; the Gateway applies no limit of its own to Jev calls.
